plateau_trigger: within-stage stop H fails to improve by 1e-5 for 15 epochs; change LR only, no model/optimizer/RNG rollback
plateau_early_stop: only after final LR stage has run >=20 epochs and global best has not improved for 30 epochs; min40 overall
branch_semantics: reset/retain branch from same fresh best model and RNG; retain loads actual same-epoch AdamW state, reset starts empty AdamW state; both LR1e-4; not continuation from phase1 terminal epoch
budget_semantics: fresh/plateau each <=300epoch/900sec; reset/retain have an additional <=300epoch/900sec plus source cost, not compute-matched to one-stage training
old_overnight_results: reuse existing three mean_continue observations as context only; old checkpoints lack optimizer state
selection: stop group-macro H and actual cost, evaluation exposed development; no new-C or AFDB claim
promotion: at most six additional fits including any new source fit; prefer distinct fold/seed for best useful policy, no architecture expansion
